## Teaching points

1. Failure of outpatient treatment and systemic illness warrant evaluation for an abscess or other complication.
2. CT defines the collection and guides source control; a large drainable abscess often needs more than antibiotics.
3. Initial improvement with fluids does not remove the need for inpatient care.
